question: How does kala produce limited doership mutually with the atom?
premises: kala produces limited doership from self-embrace of the atom
of that too, atom with atom mutually
inference: Kala-atom mutuality births agency, as in collyrium.
uncertainties: anjane (in collyrium) analogy kept per gloss
plain_english: For kala produces limited doership from self-embrace of the atom — of that too, atom with atom mutually; in collyrium she is born.
